description: Add an alert recipient: an email address, phone number (sms), webhook URL, Slack-compatible incoming-webhook URL, or Microsoft Teams webhook URL. Returns the new (or already-existing) recipient with its id. By default it is selected on ALL existing checks; pass selected=false to add it unattached. Slack/Telegram/Zapier/Statuspage integrations must be set up in the web UI. Requires the read/write API key. updown: POST /api/recipients.

name.description: Optional friendly label (webhooks only at the moment).

selected.description: true (default) = selected on all existing checks; false = not selected on any check.

value.description: The email address, phone number or URL.

name: updown_add_recipient
title: Add an alert recipient
